notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
I took the summer off from Condo and just enjoyed watching people explore this little world from a distance. Still, a few things kept bugging me, so here’s what’s new in 1.0.3:

Controller Support:
Plug in your Xbox or PlayStation controller for a fully mouse-and-keyboard-free experience. Playing on Steam Deck should feel much smoother too.

World Updates:
I’ve sprinkled in a few small touches, including a hidden event for the curious few.

Performance Upgrades:
ᕙ( •̀ ᗜ •́ )ᕗ 


ok bye
xoxo

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.notes:
It was absolutely thrilling to read your response to Condo during its first days of release! ♥ Thanks to you all, I was able to further fine-tune the game, which is insanely appreciated. Anyway, here’s what’s new in 1.0.2.



Wider resolution support: 
The game is designed for a 4:3 aspect ratio and will automatically switch to 1440x1080. However, players using different resolutions - or systems that don't support the default - will now see the UI adapt accordingly. If there's still any issues here, let me know!



Minor world tweaks:
Just small things here and there. I decided not to fix the out-of-bounds glitch because, honestly, it looks super fun.



Future updates: ヘ(* 。* ヘ)
I’m not ready to move on from Condo yet. There are some ideas that I would still like to implement. Not sure when though; I’m figuring out how to test the Linux build first. Will keep you posted!


xoxo

notes.title: Release Date Reveal - Condo Releases June 25th!
notes.notes:
Condo will be releasing on June 25th!

In this short, atmospheric game you'll be wandering through a quiet condo complex - talking to neighbors, listening to the rain, and trying your best to make time stand still. If you like moody spaces and aimless nighttime strolls, you might just get something out of it.

The game will be completely free when it launches, so feel free to check it out whenever the mood strikes.

Thanks so much to everyone who’s wishlisted or shared the page. It means a lot!
If you're curious, you can wishlist Condo over here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3739210/Condo/
xoxo
